title: Cutting-Edge Topics Coming Up At The A4M BHRT Symposium • A4M Blog
abstract:
[Module I: Peptide Therapy Certification](https://go.a4m.com/3L2NnAc)  
The respected[A4M Peptide Therapy Certification](https://go.a4m.com/3L2NnAc)course offers in-depth training and evidence-based education on the latest clinical applications, treatment protocols, legislation, and all other topics needed to master peptide therapeutics. This year, the module will explore practical considerations such as FDA and state regulations, legal guidelines, and manufacturing and quality control. It will also delve into clinical applications of peptide therapeutics for whole-person care, covering metabolic optimization, insulin regulation, hormone, and immune modulation, and metaflammation reduction.  
Renowned peptide experts will also cover lifestyle considerations in peptide medicine relevant to clinicians today and unique patient cases designed to prepare participants for any kind of clinical scenario. Finally, the three-day course will investigate the latest breakthroughs and evidence in peptide therapies, surveying potential future applications, and the newest scientific advancements.  
Learn more about the certification program[here](https://go.a4m.com/3L2NnAc).  
Neurology and Brain Health  
[Module III: Frontiers in Neurology and Brain Health](https://go.a4m.com/3L4h6ZF)
[Module III: Frontiers in Neurology and Brain Health](https://go.a4m.com/3L4h6ZF)  
Neuropsychiatric and neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s disease have reached epidemic proportions; they are now one of the leading causes of disabilities worldwide. In response to the growing brain health crisis,[Module III](https://go.a4m.com/3L4h6ZF)aims to provide healthcare professionals with comprehensive training in functional medicine strategies and clinical protocols to combat common neurological disorders.  
This course will cover recent developments in the burgeoning field of psycho-neuro-immunology and the gut-neuro-endocrine axis and how they have defined the critical relationships between the brain and all bodily systems at the cellular and sub-cellular levels. Further, famed neurology specialists will explore innovative treatment modalities, such as psychedelic medicine and functional psychiatry, lifestyle interventions, inflammatory pathways, and infectious agents in the context of brain health.  
Find out more about Module III’s agenda and the event by clicking[here](https://go.a4m.com/3L4h6ZF).  
Metabolic Resiliency, Immunocompetence, and Biotransformation
Metabolic Resiliency, Immunocompetence, and Biotransformation  
With more than 50 million Americans now suffering from one or more autoimmune disorders, there is an urgent need for a greater focus on autoimmunity in modern medicine.[Module VII](https://go.a4m.com/3exuSrE)aims to meet the demand for advanced education in this field, focusing on adaptive immune system dysregulation, inflammaging, metaflammation, and autoimmune disease.  
Based on a system’s biology approach, the course will investigate the assessment and treatment of chronic inflammation – the underlying cause of many autoimmune syndromes. Advanced neurologic specialists will cover the latest and most relevant topics, including psycho-neuro-immunology, peptide science, dental health, gut microbiota influence, hormonal effects on immunity, and advancements in autoimmune disease treatment.  
For more information about Module VII, the agenda, and the faculty panel, please click[here](https://go.a4m.com/3exuSrE).  
As part of A4M’s mission to equip medical practitioners with the latest, most comprehensive evidence-based education, the upcoming[BHRT Symposium](https://go.a4m.com/3B6vKv7), and co-occurring modules offer an unparalleled opportunity to gain invaluable clinical protocols and insights from the world’s experts.Learn more about this educational experience and future events [here](https://www.a4m.com/conferences-and-educational-events.html).
